title: single-row client-collateral read-back returns a computed valuation for client 5 holding 2
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture client-collateral-single-raw.json (GET /clients/5/collaterals/2, tenant gerege): the oracle returned the SINGLE holding row WITH a computed valuation — quantity 1.50000, total 150000.0000000000, totalCollateral 75000.000000000000000 — even though the DB column holds only quantity (SQL-verified: m_client_collateral_management has no total column), so total = base_price * quantity and total_collateral = total * pct_to_base/100 are computed by the read path, exactly the arithmetic ClientCollateral.Total / TotalCollateral ports. The two valuation fields are transcribed as scale-5 integer counts: total 150000.0000000000 -> "15000000000", total_collateral 75000.000000000000000 -> "7500000000". Nothing was recomputed by this promotion.
